old: a runtime can keep user contents under ~/home between sessions when it is launched with that option, and a paused runtime takes a snapshot; the pricing page and the environments page give no retention period
new: a runtime launched with the Home Folder keeps contents across sandbox sessions: the User folder is mounted at /home/datalayer/{user-handle} in the sandbox, from home/users/{user-uid} on the shared filesystem, and deleting or replacing the sandbox does not delete it; a paused runtime takes a snapshot that keeps its state; the pricing page and the environments page give no retention period, and the Home Folder page gives no length for the trash retention window

evidence.proved: the persisted User folder is home/users/{user-uid} on the shared filesystem and appears in the sandbox at /home/datalayer/{user-handle}, not under ~/home

reason: the disputed path is settled by the Home Folder page's mount table: the folder is at /home/datalayer/{user-handle} in the sandbox, so the former ~/home was wrong; the survival, pause and no-period clauses are cited by the rows appended below

evidence.proved: the Home Folder survives individual sandbox sessions
evidence.quote: The Home Folder is private storage that belongs to a Datalayer user and survives individual Code Sandbox sessions.

evidence.proved: deleting or replacing a sandbox leaves the Home Folder in place
evidence.quote: Deleting or replacing a sandbox does not delete it.

evidence.proved: a deleted file is purged after a retention window whose length the page does not give
evidence.quote: After a retention window the trash is purged — the file is removed from disk and its quota is freed.

evidence.proved: deleting a sandbox removes its working files and leaves the persistent sources, the Home Folder among them
evidence.quote: Restarting or reconnecting reconciles the declared attachments at the same paths; deleting the sandbox removes working files but does not delete persistent sources.

evidence.proved: a paused runtime preserves its state as a snapshot
evidence.quote: Pausing preserves Agent Runtime state and creates an [Agent Runtime Snapshot](https://datalayer.ai/docs/code-sandbox-snapshots).

evidence.proved: pausing stops the sandbox and keeps its state
evidence.quote: Unlike [pausing](https://datalayer.ai/docs/code-sandboxes) it, which stops the sandbox to keep its state.

evidence.proved: the pricing page is unchanged and states no retention period
evidence.quote: Sandbox usage consumes wallet credits while environments are running.
